[ffff64]Rode Zaag Range[ffffff]
Hmm, we have to climb this mountain, right?
Looks like it's gonna be a tough journey.\nI do see something that looks like a trail\nthough~.
If you ask me, I'd say it's more like a "beaten\ntrack" made by animals...
Oh, speak of the devil, here come the rulers of\nthe trail.
Coenubia...
Yeah, these beasts are infested with Coenubias.\nLooks like this mountain is under Coenubias'\ncontrol~.
That means there's no turning back!\nWe gotta move forward and take down those Coenubia\nmonsters!
Huff...huff... \nAre we still far from the summit~?\nI'm about to collapse here~.
Man, this is quite tough.\nI think we're only a third of the way there.
Unda said we could make it easily, and Kunon said\nwe should have no trouble making it through...\nAargh~, I wish they'd stop overestimating us~.
Aye? I've still got plenty of energy!
Shut up, you little runt!
Hahaha, who's calling who a little runt?\nYou're the real little runt!
W-what? How dare you say that!
Hey, knock it off. Shorties shouldn't fight each\nother...
Looks like it's rare to find an open area like\nthis around here. I don't see any Coenubia either.\nLet's rest for a while!
What is it? Anything wrong...?!
What the...! The trail ends here, we can't go any\nfurther!
My gosh!!\nD-don't tell me we've come all this way for\nnothing?!
Aye, are we turning back?
You've gotta be kidding me~!! Coming all this way\njust to go home with nothing...Even a saint like\nme would flip out!!
Whoa! Wow! Who are you?!
My gosh?! Why don't you tell us who you are!
I didn't expect anyone to be living in the middle\nof nowhere like this.\nAnd boy, you're a weredragon, aren't you?!
S-so what?! You're a weredragon too, and there's\na Lixi with you...and I'm seeing a race I've never\nseen before here!
Besides, I'm the one who should be surprised.\nHow did you end up in the middle of nowhere like\nthis? There are Coenubias everywhere!
Hmph!! We took care of all those Coenubias!
This adventurer did most of the work, though.
What?!\nYou took care of every single Coenubia, even those\nat the foothills?!
Hey, boy, do you know the way to get past this\nmountain?
Stop calling me "boy", I'm not a kid anymore.\nMy name is Radi. You can call me Radi.
Unfortunately, the trail ends here.\nBut it's not like there's nothing you can do...
Huh?\nWhat is it? Stop beating around the bush and just\nspit it out!
Maybe Puiet knows something.
Puiet?
Yeah, Puiet, the Spirit Tree. He's the ruler of\nthis mountain, and also my savior...
Wow?! It's a cave!! Were you hiding it all this\ntime?!
It's not the way to get past the mountain, though.\nFollow me! I have something to tell you...\nAnd I have a little favor to ask.
There are many monsters in this cave too. Since\nyou've made it this far safely, I proly don't need\nto warn you, but it's better to be careful.
So, do we follow him~?
Radi said the Spirit Tree might know where we\nshould go next, didn't he?
Yeah, and he also said he had a little favor to\nask, right~?
Well, I guess that's the only option we have now~.
Alright!\nLet's hurry and catch up to Radi before we lose\nhim!
